keynums.label: Total income by segment, Q1 FY26-27 — Textile Business
Total income by segment, Q1 FY26-27 — Investments

bull_bear.body:
- Board declared an interim dividend of ₹0.50 per equity share at its meeting held on August 08, 2026; the deck frames this as the Board continuing "its dividend track record".
- "The post-quarter buyback (up to 11.04 lakh shares at ₹250/share) reduces share count and reinforces confidence in the growth trajectory."
- Finance costs declined 16.1% YoY to ₹37.70 Lakhs, which the deck says is "consistent with a lighter debt/working-capital burden and improving balance sheet efficiency".
- ROCE (operating pre-tax, TTM) shown at 20% for Q1'26, 25% for Q4'26 and 25% for Q1'27, described as ▲+5.0 pp YoY.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Orbit Exports is a manufacturer and exporter of value-added fabrics, producing fancy jacquards, novelty and fashion fabrics alongside home-textile and finished made-up."
- Serves apparel, home-furnishing and occasion-specific fabric markets across the US, Europe, the Middle East, Latin America, Africa and Southeast Asia, "working with leading retailers and brands worldwide" — i.e. an export-led customer base rather than a domestic one.
- Reports on a consolidated basis under two segments per Ind AS 108 — Textile Business and Investments — with Investments disclosed as a separate reportable segment alongside the core textile operation.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Trade policy] "The recent easing of tariffs by the United States has had a positive impact on Indian textile exporters, improving cost competitiveness and order visibility as compared to the same period last year."
- [Trade policy] The India–UK Free Trade Agreement "is expected to be a long-term positive for the industry, gradually opening up preferential access to a large export market, although its full benefit will be realised only over the coming years as trade flows adjust."
- [Geopolitical risk] "The ongoing Middle East crisis continues to weigh on global logistics, keeping shipping costs elevated and disrupting established trade routes; as a result, overall business volumes to the region for the quarter remain volatile."
- [Segment mix] Total income by segment for Q1 FY26-27: Textile Business ₹7,819.13 Lakhs (88.9%) and Investments ₹972.33 Lakhs (11.1%); the deck notes the Textile Business result includes share of profit of associate and "may differ from standalone figures presented elsewhere in this presentation".
- [Segment assets] The segment-assets chart carries values 27.9k / 6.9k (Jun'25), 28.0k / 9.3k (Mar'26) and 29.6k / 12.1k (Jun'26) in ₹ Lakhs against a legend reading Textile Business then Investments, with total segment assets marked ▲+20.1% YoY; the extraction preserves the pair order but not an explicit label on each value, so the split is reported as the deck presents it rather than asserted per series.
